item.text: {"question_id":"5B.2","answer":"For 2023, the evidence confirms that Tshisekedi directly appointed and reshuffled economic and public-enterprise personnel, including the economy, finance, planning, mines, and related portfolios (BATCH-0009-E003; BATCH-0008-E014; BATCH-0018-E004). The World Bank also reported competitively selected leaders for power and water utilities and the national road fund, but attributed these measures to Congolese authorities collectively and did not establish Tshisekedi’s personal selection process or the appointees’ qualifications (BATCH-0014-E002). The Gécamines account shows presidential appointment and guidance on managing mining assets, but only records a work plan and orientations, not operational independence, implementation, or performance-based retention (BATCH-0018-E004). The central bank’s rate decision and reported non-financing pact indicate institutional economic action, but the decision was made by the Monetary Policy Committee and is not direct evidence of presidential empowerment or appointment criteria (BATCH-0023-E020). Overall, the record supports presidential appointment authority and some institution-level professionalization, but does not establish qualified selection, credible personal processes, operational independence, or retention and replacement based on performance. Attribution is therefore stronger for appointments than for professional quality, independence, or performance management.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0009-E003","BATCH-0008-E014","BATCH-0018-E004","BATCH-0014-E002"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0009-E003","BATCH-0008-E014","BATCH-0018-E004","BATCH-0014-E002","BATCH-0023-E020"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The supplied evidence does not document selection criteria, qualifications, political ties, operational autonomy, performance reviews, or performance-based retention or replacement for the named economic appointees.","The competitive-appointment evidence is institution-level, attributed to Congolese authorities collectively, and reports measures without full implementation or outcome evidence.","The central-bank evidence concerns an autonomous institutional decision and does not establish presidential direction or empowerment.","No direct evidence supplied here links the appointments to subsequent economic performance. "],"corrections_made":["Removed judicial appointment and removal evidence as irrelevant to the specific economic-personnel question.","Qualified the World Bank evidence so it no longer implies personal presidential selection or proof of qualified appointments.","Qualified the central-bank evidence so it is treated as indirect institutional context rather than evidence of Tshisekedi’s appointment or empowerment decisions.","Retained the documented appointment authority and Gécamines engagement while separating appointments and guidance from professional quality, independence, and performance-based personnel management."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":[]}
